notes.title: Important information
notes.content:
With this announcement, we want to notify you about the immediate prospects for the [b]TinShift[/b] game.

We have decided to change the development strategy of this game and make "TinShift" [u]free[/u].
This will allow us to increase the number of players and give more confidence in continuing to work on the project.

We are extremely grateful to everyone who has shown interest in this game, despite the early access stage. Especially, thanks to all those who purchased the game earlier, because they made it possible to purchase separate equipment for the stable operation of the server dedicated to TinShift.

Thus, in the near future we hope to see more people and robots in the arena!

notes.title: TinShift features: upgrade of robots
notes.content:
Robot is your choice in TinShift? Then make him the best robot among robots.

Let's get to know the game ahead of its release.

Only a few hours left before TinShift release time, when you will have possibility to play as both humans and robots. Each of them has its own characteristics. Robots are armed to the teeth from the start of the game, but they are inferior to people in dynamics and few abilities (running along walls, moving up stairs). But you can try to compensate that by improving your robot via updating his components.

The next components of your robot can be upgraded:
[olist]
[*] body (4 types);
[*] alloy (12 types);
[*] reactor (12 types);
[*] weapons (5 types);
[*] modules (9 passive and 3 active);
[*] ultimates (5 superpowers).
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38602618/1787f74634aa88974583e45fd89d123f94cb3ea9.jpg[/img]

If you have questions about the game, you can ask other TinShift players and developers directly at [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/ra6dMryMKr]Discord[/url][/b]!  
Follow our pages in Facebook, Twitter, Vkontakte, Instagram, Reddit to know more about the upgrades of every of this components. 

Call your friends, because further TinShift world will be only more better and more cooler. 
More people - more fun!

notes.title: TinShift features: assortment of weapons
notes.content:
Let's get to know the game ahead of its release. There are available [b]10 types of different weapons[/b], includling exclusive, in the game.

Some are classic, others will have to be used wisely and according to the situation.
Some of them are created totally from the scratch by our designers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38602618/5bf9ff7ab2826fe5e79fbfdb42c443277b2385e6.png[/img]

If you choose the human's side, then choose your "friends" - rapid-fire NP-45 or Arctic Warfare, Boogieman or the long-range Raptor,...

But don't forget, that your brain, speed and strategy are your main weapons on TinShift arena.

📍  In regard of soon release we invite you to our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/ra6dMryMKr]Discord channel[/url][/b] to celebrate and to play together. 

Call your friends, because further TinShift world will be only more better and more cooler. 
More people - more fun!

notes.title: TinShift features: Return in time
notes.content:
Let's get to know the game ahead of its release. TinShift has different interesting features and return in time is among them.

[b]Return in time[/b] is a real thing. 
Due to the excessive dynamics, it is often not possible to immediately respond to a surprise attack or a stray sniper bullet. 
Therefore everyone has a second chance - to change the course of events with a rollback 10 seconds back. 
This chance recharges when you successfully kill an enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38602618/81d9aa722a775ea9b65a227836b5305b9c82a3e1.gif[/img]
